media.title: Harold Adamson — portrait photograph
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the lyricist Harold Adamson.
media.publicCaption: Harold Adamson, American lyricist. Adamson wrote the words for “Ninon” (1935), set to music by Kaper.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; via the Songwriters Hall of Fame and English Wikipedia.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The English Wikipedia file page holds the image as non-free content and states that copyright is most likely held by the photographer or their employer, without identifying either; no rights holder has been traced and the source is a non-profit hall of fame rather than a commercial picture agency. A reduced-resolution reproduction (286 × 348 px) is used here for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator.
